generic function.description:
TS 1.0 (generics)
function name<T>(arg: T): T
A reusable function whose parameter/return types are tied together by a type variable, resolved separately at each call site.

generic constraint.description:
TS 1.8
function name<T extends Constraint>(arg: T): T
Restricts a generic's allowed types to those assignable to the constraint (`extends`), enabling access to the constraint's members inside the function.

generic default type parameter.description:
TS 2.3
generic default type parameter
Supplies a fallback type used when the generic isn't explicitly specified at the usage site — like a default function parameter, but for types.
